# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:

- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: An abbreviated form# of 犛 yak + 毛 hair → *tail of a yak*, one attached to a pennant/banner (compare 旄 and 氅) → *tail*; *yak*; *hair*.
犛牛尾也。从犛省，从毛。
敞# high and wide + 毛 hair (→ fur) → *fur attached to a pennant/banner* raised high (compare 氂). Also, via association with covering elements of creatures, *feathers* → *feathered robe*.
析鳥羽爲旗纛之屬。从毛敞聲。
As per 亶# (long and flat) + 毛 hair → long, flat piece of fabric → *woolen mat*; *rug*; *carpet*. Compare 毯.
撚毛也。从毛亶聲。
氍毹、毾㲪，皆氊緂之屬，蓋方言也。从毛瞿聲。
A depiction of a flat digging implement. *Clan*, *lineage*, *family name*, *birth* and *background* are borrowed meanings → *Mr./Mrs./Ms.*.
巴蜀山名岸脅之㫄箸欲落𡐦者曰氏，氏崩，聞數百里。象形，乀聲。凡氏之屬皆从氏。楊雄賦：響若氏隤。
As per 氏# (dig) + a line beneath → dig to/press the *low* point or *foundation* of an object → *base*. Also, name of an *ancient tribe*.
至也。从氏下箸一。一，地也。凡氐之屬皆从氐。

A depiction of an eye blinded in being pierced by a needle → blinding of a slave → *people* (← subservient masses who go blindly about their lives) → *nation*. Note that in contrast to 目, the bronzeware inscription form of 民 lacks a pupil. For the blinding of slaves, compare 艮, 敃, 僕 and 童.
眾萌也。从古文之象。凡民之屬皆从民。
木本。从氏。大於末。讀若厥。
As per 亡# (obscure) + 民 people → obscure (= marginalized) *people* → *immigrants*; *subjects*.
民也。从民亡聲。讀若盲。
A depiction of steam/vapors rising (compare 乙) to fill a room or container → *steam*.
雲气也。象形。凡气之屬皆从气。
An abbreviated form# of 雰 mist/fog + 气 rising vapors (→ air/atmosphere) → mist/fog as one manifestation of *air*, *atmosphere* or *weather*.
祥气也。从气分聲。
气# steam + 米 rice → vapors rising from steaming rice → *breath*; *spirit* → *vitality*; *mood*.
饋客芻米也。从米气聲。《春秋傳》曰：“齊人來氣諸矦。”
As per 因# (superimpose) + 气 rising vapors (→ air/atmosphere) → *heavy fog/mist* (← layers of fog).
As per 𥁕# as described in 温 (hold in/down) + 气 rising vapors (→ air/atmosphere) → *unity of and harmony between heaven and earth* (compare 尹).
A depiction of a long, winding flow of *water*.
凖也。北方之行。象眾水並流，中有微陽之气也。凡水之屬皆从水。

The relevant seal inscription form shows cracks spreading over the ice of a river frozen in winter → *ice* → *be frozen*; *freezing cold*. In dual-element characters such as 凍 凅 and 凋, 氷 appears in the form 冫.
A depiction of flowing water splitting into numerous distributaries that stretch far into the distance → *long period of time*; *everlasting*; *forever*.
長也。象水坙理之長。《詩》曰：“江之永矣。”凡永之屬皆从永。
As per the right-hand element# as described in 犯 (spread although encompassed by a framing object) + 水 water → *overflow*; *flood* → *spread (extensively/widely*). Compare 汎.
濫也。从水㔾聲。
As per 九# (bump up against and bend/curve) + 水 water → *spring* near the base of a cliff, with the discharged water curving away after hitting the cliff .
水厓枯土也。从水九聲。《爾雅》曰：“水醮曰氿。”
As per 丁# (straight) + 水 water → straight sandbanks or *shore(line)/waterside* → *beach*. Compare 渚.
平也。从水丁聲。
As per 十# (gather) + 水 water → liquid gathered at the bottom of a container/bowl → *juice*; *soup*; *gravy* → *sap*.
液也。从水十聲。

A depiction of an animal pelt, complete with head and limbs, that would be wrapped about oneself for warmth (compare 㒼 as described in 滿, 皮 and 表, as well as 韋) → *draw tight* → *want* (← draw a desired object tightly into one's possession) → *seek*; *search for*; *request*; *ask* (for); *demand*; *buy*. In derivative characters, 求 conveys the concept "wrap" (← wrap a pelt about the body).
西極之水也。从水八聲。《爾雅》曰：“西至汃國，謂四極。”

entries.text: 激水聲也。从水勺聲。井一有水、一無水，謂之瀱汋。
泣淚皃。从水丸聲。
As per 凡# (spread and encompass) + 水 water → objects encompassed by the water in which they *float* → *wide* (← wide expanse of water) → *universally*.
浮皃。从水凡聲。
淅𤃦也。从水大聲。
夕# evening + 水 water → *evening tide* → *tide*. Compare 渚 (waves lapping at the shore).
浮行水上也。从水从子。古或以汓爲没。
水涸也。或曰泣下。从水气聲。《詩》曰：“汽可小康。”
As per 山# (dense/lumpy objects) + 水 water → group of caught fish, swimming in a basket → *fish swimming*.
魚游水皃。从水山聲。《詩》曰：“蒸然汕汕。”
As per 干# (press against) + 水 water → *sweat* pressing against the skin.
人液也。从水干聲。
水也。从水千聲。
薉也。一曰小池爲汙。一曰涂也。从水于聲。
The relevant seal inscription form is 于# (U-shaped) + 水 water → U-shaped puddle → *dirty*; *filthy* (← stagnant water) → *soil*; *corrupt*; *disgrace*; *taint* → *impure*; *mean*; *base* → *rape*.
As per 卂# as described in 迅 (tight formation) + 水 water → tight concentration of liquid, that overflows → *overflow* → *pour* (← pour to the point of overflowing).
灑也。从水卂聲。
As per 巳# (descendant) + 水 water → *distributary* (← figurative descendant of a main waterway). Also, *shore* and *pool* (← endpoints of a distributary).
水別復入水也。一曰汜，窮瀆也。从水巳聲。《詩》曰：“江有汜。”
As per 女# (supple) + 水 water → softly/gently curving watercourse (originally, the name of a river in China). *You* is a borrowed meaning.
水。出弘農盧氏還歸山，東入淮。从水女聲。
As per 工# (connecting pipe/tube) + 水 water → *mercury* (contained in a tube, and used medicinally in ancient China).
As per 工# (connecting pipe/tube) + 水 water → *inlet* connecting to a settlement → *river*; *bay*.
水。出蜀湔氐徼外崏山，入海。从水工聲。
A variant form of 沱 (long flow of water), combining 也# (stretch) and 水 water. The term came to signify a narrow stretch of water, then eventually *pond*.
水都也。从水支聲。
著止也。从水氏聲。
水。出扶風汧縣西北，入渭。从水幵聲。
長沙汨羅淵，屈原所沈之水。从水，冥省聲。
治水也。从水曰聲。
As per 王# (extend) + 水 water → *widespread water* (compare 泂, 潢 and 浤); *great volume* (of water; compare 滉 and 洸). Also, a *large pond* (← water-filled depression).
深廣也。从水王聲。一曰汪，池也。
A variant form of 泏 (出 protrude + 水 water) → *bend in a river*; *confluence* → *inlet*. 内 replaces 出 to indicate a shift in the initial consonant from T- to N-; compare 訥, 吶, 蚋, 芮 and 枘.
水相入也。从水从内，内亦聲。
As per 太# (great) + 水 water → sift in a great amount of water and *sort*/*select* by quality. Compare 淘.
As per 及# (press on) + 水 water → *draw water* (← lower a bucket to the point that it presses down beyond the surface of well water) → *scoop* (up/out); *ladle* (out) → *pour* (tea).
引水於井也。从水从及，及亦聲。
水。受陳畱浚儀陰溝，至蒙爲雝水，東入于泗。从水反聲。
水。出琅邪朱虛東泰山，東入濰。从水文聲。桑欽說：汶水出泰山萊蕪，西南入泲。
水也。从水夂聲。夂，古文終。
As per 夬# (scoop out) + 水 water → scoop out earth in breaching a dam → *decide*; *determine*; *settle* (← cut through to a decision ← cut an opening; compare 判, 斷, 裁 and 折).
行流也。从水从夬。廬江有決水，出於大別山。
水厓也。从水午聲。
气# steam + 水 water (for emphasis/clarification) → *steam*.
水。出太原晉陽山，西南入河。从水分聲。或曰出汾陽北山，冀州浸。
As per 心# (heart of an object) + 水 water → liquid that seeps into/penetrates the heart of an object → *penetrate*; *seep/soak into*.
水。出上黨羊頭山，東南入河。从水心聲。
水。出東海費東，西入泗。从水斤聲。一曰沂水，出泰山蓋青州浸。
As per 夭# (slender and limber) + 水 water → *irrigate*; *pour* (← slender stream of water) → *fertile* (← soil made fertile by irrigation).
轉流也。从水云聲。讀若混。
水。出牂牁故且蘭，東北入江。从水元聲。
As per 亢# (stretch) + 水 water → *long stretch of water* (compare 泱). Also, in a vertical application of the same idea, a *tall jet/spray of water*.
莽沆，大水也。从水亢聲。一曰大澤皃。
水。出河東東垣王屋山，東爲泲。从水允聲。

The relevant oracle bone form of 冘 shows that it originally combined 川 river and 牛 cow → drive cattle across a river, their bodies sinking in being largely submerged. A bronzeware inscription form alters the character by showing a person weighed down by a heavy bar across the shoulders → slump; sink. 沈 is 冘# + 水 water → sinking person/object (compare 没) → *sink*; *immerse*; *submerge* → *go down*; *set*; *be mired in*.
陵上滈水也。从水冘聲。一曰濁黕也。
水也。从水尤聲。
As per 屯# (swollen) + 水 water → swollen/turbid waters → *confusion*; *chaos*. *Stagnate* is a borrowed meaning.
As per 互# (fit together) + 水 water → close off a sluice (compare 閘) → *drying up/closing off of a source of water* → *close* (an open object). *Freeze* is a borrowed meaning via 冱.
As per 木# (cover) + 水 water → cover oneself with water in bathing → *wash* (one's hair/body); *bathe*.
濯髮也。从水木聲。
水吏也。又，溫也。从水丑聲。
沈也。从水从𠬸。
A variant form of 枼 as described in 葉 (pile) → *pile*; *stack*. *Shoe* is a borrowed meaning via 鞜.
語多沓沓也。从水从曰。遼東有沓縣。
水。出武都沮縣東狼谷，東南入江。或曰入夏水。从水丏聲。

中# center/middle + 水 water → extract flavor from tea by infusing in hot water. In Japan, however, 沖 has been reinterpreted as 中 center/middle + 水 water → point midway between the shore and deep waters of a lake or the open waters of a sea → *offshore*; *offing*; *open sea*.
涌搖也。从水、中。讀若動。

entries.text: 少 here a variant form of 次# (align) + 水 water → sift *sand* in aligning and sorting out desired objects → *sort*; *select*.
水𢿱石也。从水从少。水少沙見。楚東有沙水。
止# (stand straight) + 水 water → straight line of *sandbanks* or sandbars → *sandbar*.
小渚曰沚。从水止聲。《詩》曰：“于沼于沚。”
As per the right-hand element# of 肺 (split right and left) + 水 water → *abundant* water splitting off right and left → extensive *swamp/marsh*.
水。出遼東番汗塞外，西南入海。从水巿聲。
二水也。闕。凡沝之屬皆从沝。

The relevant seal inscription form shows that the right-hand element# (traditionally written as per the right-hand element of 歿) was originally swirling water + a hand → body dimly visible in the water in which it is submerged (compare 沈). 水 water was appended for emphasis/clarification → *sink* → *die*.
As per 末# (minute) + 水 water → minute *foam*, *froth* or *suds* → *spray*; *splash*.
水。出蜀西徼外，東南入江。从水末聲。
洒面也。从水未聲。
水。出青州浸。从水术聲。
As per 且# (pile) + 水 water → impediment that creates a buildup of water → *impede*; *disturb* → *be dejected/discouraged* (← encounter impediments to obtaining one's desires).
水。出漢中房陵，東入江。从水且聲。
As per 它# (stretch) + 水 water → long flow (of a river, stream or other waterway). In Japan, the character is used with respect to a *flow of tears*.
江別流也。出㟭山東，別爲沱。从水它聲。
As per 可# (bend) + 水 water → long *river* with multiple bends. Compare 川.
水。出焞煌塞外昆侖山，發原注海。从水可聲。
水不利也。从水㐱聲。《五行傳》曰：“若其沴作。”
As per 弗# (split) + 水 water → splitting away of bubbles (compare 泡) on the surface of boiling water → *boil*.
滭沸，濫泉。从水弗聲。
As per 由# (pass/run through) + 水 water/liquid → *oil* running through the mouth of its container in being poured.
水。出武陵孱陵西，東南入江。从水由聲。
田# field + 水 water → *flooding* of a field (compare 衍); *turbulent waters*.
As per 台# (heavy downward pressure) + 水 water → work to *control* the heavy pressure exerted by a powerful river → *quell*; *calm/settle down*; *subside*; *govern(ment)*; *peace*; *healing*; *cure*.
水。出東萊曲城陽丘山，南入海。从水台聲。
As per 召# (curve) + 水 water → *marsh*/*swamp* with a curving shore.
池水。从水召聲。
古# hard; dried out + 水 water → drought-prone body of water. *Buy* and *sell* are borrowed meanings, via 估.
水。出漁陽塞外，東入海。从水古聲。
As per 占# (fixed in place) + 水 water → fix objects in a tub and *soak* them → *moisten*.
水。出壺關，東入淇。一曰沾，益也。从水占聲。

As per 水# (long, winding flow of water) + an obsolete character indicating a ravine (compare 谷) → water splitting into branches as it follows/runs along a winding, prescribed course in a ravine → *run along*; *lie along*; *follow* (a custom/rule).
緣水而下也。从水㕣聲。《春秋傳》曰：“王沿夏。”
As per 兄# (extend) + 水 water → extensive body of water. *Situation* is a borrowed meaning.
寒水也。从水兄聲。
冋# as described in 冂 (distant) + 水 water → *distant* *expanse of water reaching far and wide* (compare 汪, 潢 and 浤). Also, *cold* (← chilly waters).
滄也。从水冋聲。
世# successive + 水 water → successive flow on account of leakage → *leak*; *flow*. Compare 洩.
水。受九江博安洵波，北入氐。从水丗聲。
As per 囚# (enclose) + 水 water → body enclosed/surrounded by water in swimming/floating → *swim*; *float*.
失# lose + 水 water → container that loses its liquid contents → *overflow* → *dissipated* → *licentious*.
水所蕩泆也。从水失聲。
A depiction of a thin stream of water spouting from a round *spring* → *fountain*; *fountainhead*.
水原也。象水流出成川形。凡泉之屬皆从泉。
As per 白# (scatter) + 水 water → tethered rafts/boats scattered over the surface of water (compare 舶) → *be anchored*; *wharf*; *lodge*; *overnight stay*; *shoal*; *shallow lake*; *shallows*.
As per 必# (split) + 水 water → liquid that splits in flowing in separate streams → *flow* → *secretion*.
俠流也。从水必聲。
水皃。从水出聲。讀若窋。
水石之理也。从水从阞。《周禮》曰：“石有時而泐。”
澤。在昆侖下。从水幼聲。讀與𣢜同。
水。起雁門葰人戍夫山，東北入海。从水瓜聲。
弘# wide + 水 water → *wide*, deep body of (clear) water.
下深皃。从水弘聲。
周謂潘曰泔。从水甘聲。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form is 水 water + an element# combining 去 (withdraw) and 廌 imaginary beast with a single horn → cause a creature to withdraw to an island → *law* (← enjoy freedom of action within the framework of the law ← enjoy freedom of movement within the confines of an island; compare 憲 律 笵and 埒) → *fixed way of doing*; *rule*; *Buddhist truth*; *follow*; *model*. The 廌 element eventually dropped.
受泲水，東入淮。从水四聲。
谷也。从水平聲。
清也。从水此聲。
A variant form of 汎 float: *float*; *rise*; *cover*; *arise*. *Overturn* and *capsize* are borrowed meanings.
浮也。从水乏聲。
水。在常山。从水氐聲。
As per 斥# (split) + 水 water → split away and *go upstream*. Compare 溯.
逆流而上曰㴑洄。㴑，向也。水欲下違之而上也。从水㡿聲。
As per 令# (long sequence) + 水 water → flow of cool, clean water (compare 涼) → *cool*; *clean*.
水。出丹陽宛陵，西北入江。从水令聲。
包# envelop + 水 water → *bubble* (pocket of air enveloped by water; compare 沸) → *foam*; *froth*.
水。出山陽平樂，東北入泗。从水包聲。
As per 皮# (align) + 水 water → waves breaking in alignment → *wave*.
水涌流也。从水皮聲。
As per 立# (exert continuous downward pressure) + 水 water → *teardrops* pressing on the cheeks → *cry*; *sob*; *weep* → *moan*; *regret*.
無聲出涕曰泣。从水立聲。
As per 尼# (close contact) + 水 water → close contact of earth and water, producing *mud* → *clingy*; *sticky*. *Thief* is via the compound 泥棒　どろぼう.
水。出北地郁郅北蠻中。从水尼聲。
瀎泧也。从水戉聲。讀若椒樧之樧。

As per 主# (stationary) + 水 water → *pour* liquid into a tubular container, where it becomes and remains stationary → *pour on*; *sprinkle*; *water* (plants); *flow/empty into*; *irrigate*. *Notice*, *pay attention*, *concentrate on*, *affix*, *interpret*, and *write down* are borrowed meanings.
灌也。从水主聲。
As per 玄# (link) + 水 water → trail created by successive drops of liquid (*tears*, *dew* etc.) winding down a surface → *cry*.
湝流也。从水玄聲。上黨有泫氏縣。
水从孔穴疾出也。从水从穴，穴亦聲。
編木以渡也。从水付聲。
半# split + 水 water → water produced by splitting/melting ice → *melt*. Compare 冸. The compound 泮宮 refers to an ancient Chinese school.
諸矦鄉射之宮，西南爲水，東北爲牆。从水从半，半亦聲。
民 here an abbreviated form# of 敃 remove by force + 水 water → remove by washing away → *die out*.
滅也。从水民聲。

The relevant seal inscription form is 大# great + an element combining 水 water and 廾 pair of hands (→ action indicator) → great outpouring of liquid (compare 太) → *calm*; *peace* (← relaxed feeling ← plenitude). *Thai(land)* is via transliteration ( 泰, or 泰國).
滑也。从廾从水，大聲。
As per 央# (stretch) + 水 water → expansive stretch of *agitated* water → *swell up*; *billow* (compare 沆). *Stagnant* and *collected water* are borrowed meanings.
滃也。从水央聲。
沇也。東入于海。从水𠂔聲。
As per 永# (stretch far) + 水 water → *float*/*swim* a long distance.
潛行水中也。从水永聲。
